divinity.name: Iovis
divinity.description: Iovis is the High Father of the Imperial pantheon, ruler of the bright heaven and giver of law. The Empire holds him supreme above the elder gods of conquered Calradia.
divinity.effects: Grants temporary martial inspiration: leadership and tactics gains.
divinity.lore: Iovis is the law that holds the Empire together. Without his hand the cities would burn and the borders crumble.
divinity.prayer: Pray to him before judgement, before battle, before any oath that must outlast you.

divinity.name: Astaronia
divinity.description: Astaronia, bride of Iovis, is the Mother of Calradia. She is honoured at the autumn equinox as the source of harvest, fertility and home.
divinity.effects: Boost to fief loyalty and child-bearing fortune for the household.
divinity.lore: Astaronia adopted the children of every people the Empire reached. To her, no field is foreign and no cradle is empty.
divinity.prayer: She is offered grain, wine and the first fruit of every season.

divinity.name: Darusos
divinity.description: Darusos is the warrior-saint of the southern legions, the executioner of traitors and patron of the iron-fisted edict.
divinity.effects: Grants combat focus and a renown bonus on righteous executions.
divinity.lore: Darusos walked among the legions and broke faithless emperors with his own hand. He is the part of the faith the rebels fear.
divinity.prayer: Where the law cannot reach, the saint will.

divinity.name: Caïon
divinity.description: Caïon is the High Lord of the Canticles, the binder of oaths and crowner of kings. The Vlandic faith holds him supreme.
divinity.effects: Boost to clan influence and oath-strength.
divinity.lore: Caïon is the breath behind every coronation. His hand sets the diadem, and only his hand may strip it.
divinity.prayer: Break a sworn oath and Caïon turns from you forever.

divinity.name: Marcosus
divinity.description: Marcosus is the warrior-saint of the lance, patron of every knight who rides under the Vlandic banner.
divinity.effects: Combat bonuses for mounted charges; renown reward on tournament victories.
divinity.lore: Marcosus rode through three hundred enemies to bring back the standard. The lance you carry is his gift.
divinity.prayer: May your saddle never empty and your banner never fall.

divinity.name: Belisaria
divinity.description: Belisaria is the lady-saint of the hearth, mother of Caïon's heirs and shelterer of widows.
divinity.effects: Increased fertility chance and lower spouse-mourning malus.
divinity.lore: Belisaria is sung of in every wedding hall of Vlandia. She blesses the marriage bed and the hearth that follows.
divinity.prayer: She watches the children no one else watches.

divinity.name: Reginus
divinity.description: Reginus is the saint of the sworn word — keeper of contracts, judge of perjurors.
divinity.effects: Reduced relation loss when terminating contracts honourably.
divinity.lore: Reginus binds liege and vassal in the same chain. Both are bound; neither may strike loose.
divinity.prayer: Speak truly, and Reginus speaks for you.

divinity.name: Pérkos
divinity.description: Pérkos is the Thunder Wielder of the highland faiths. His axe broke the Great Oak and from its sap mankind blossomed.
divinity.effects: Combat boost in storms; clan renown bonus on duel victory.
divinity.lore: Pérkos rules the canopy where the storm-clouds gather. When he strikes the oak, the world remembers it has roots.
divinity.prayer: Offer your blade to him, and the storm will not turn against you.

divinity.name: Máthair
divinity.description: Máthair is the wood-mother of the Battanian woods, who weaves and unweaves the seasons.
divinity.effects: Increased village hearth growth; pasture acreage produces more.
divinity.lore: Máthair walks under the canopy where the deer go to die. Speak softly and she may answer.
divinity.prayer: She gives, she takes, and she gives again.

divinity.name: Iarnan
divinity.description: Iarnan is the smith-spirit who taught the Fians to draw iron from the bog and sing it into a blade.
divinity.effects: Crafting bonuses; tier-up cost reductions on smithing.
divinity.lore: Every blade pulled from the lynn is Iarnan's gift back.
divinity.prayer: Honour him, and your forge will not fail you.

divinity.name: Eilean
divinity.description: Eilean is the spirit of the sacred lynns, gateway between the seen world and the underworld of ancestors.
divinity.effects: Healing speed; recover from disease faster.
divinity.lore: The pools she watches over are not for drinking. The dead drink there, and listen.
divinity.prayer: Cast a blade in, never take one out.

divinity.name: Akhmar
divinity.description: Akhmar is the One Most High, the Sun-Above-All, sovereign of the desert sky. The Aserai know no other.
divinity.effects: Trade caravan profits boost; reduced bandit interception risk while travelling.
divinity.lore: Akhmar is alone in the heaven and the heaven is enough. Speak his name and the road opens.
divinity.prayer: Submit to him and you will need no other patron.

divinity.name: Tengri
divinity.description: Tengri is the Sky Father of the steppe, eternal blue overhead, granter of fortune in war.
divinity.effects: Mounted combat bonus; party morale boost on the open map.
divinity.lore: Tengri is the lid of heaven that touches every banner. While he watches, no khan rides alone.
divinity.prayer: Pray to him at dawn, ride hard at noon, sleep under him at night.

divinity.name: Etugen
divinity.description: Etugen is the Earth Mother, the green mantle Tengri set down for the herds to graze upon.
divinity.effects: Pasture acreage yield boost; livestock count grows faster.
divinity.lore: Etugen is everything beneath the hoof. She does not speak — she nourishes.
divinity.prayer: Bury your wishes in her, and she answers in grass.

divinity.name: Sülde
divinity.description: Sülde is the spirit-banner of the war-host, embodied in the horse-tail standard each khan plants before battle.
divinity.effects: Battle morale bonus when outnumbered; influence reward for crushing victories.
divinity.lore: Sülde rides at the head of every war-band. While the banner stands, the war-band is alive.
divinity.prayer: If the banner falls, run faster than your shame.

divinity.name: Asra
divinity.description: Asra is the collective name of the steppe ancestors, who ride in the dust raised by the living host.
divinity.effects: Bonus piety on clan elder funerals; relation gain with same-culture clans.
divinity.lore: The dead ride at our backs. They keep us honest because they cannot be lied to.
divinity.prayer: Pour the first cup into the dust before you drink.

divinity.name: Frydan
divinity.description: Frydan is the warden of the long winter, who keeps the wolf-cold from breaking the houses.
divinity.effects: Winter-season food and morale penalty reduction.
divinity.lore: Frydan keeps the door barred against the dark season. Honour him before the snow comes.
divinity.prayer: A wood-pile is the truest prayer.

divinity.name: Mátr
divinity.description: Mátr is the hearth-mother of the longhouse, holder of the broth-pot and the cradle alike.
divinity.effects: Increased fertility; reduced child-illness mortality.
divinity.lore: Mátr is the warmth at the centre of the winter house. While she keeps her place, the family endures.
divinity.prayer: She listens for the cradle even when no-one else does.

divinity.name: Vethari
divinity.description: Vethari are the named ancestors of the Old Gods faith — every clan keeps a list, and every list is read at midwinter.
divinity.effects: Renown gain on funerals; piety on continuing a family line.
divinity.lore: The Vethari are not gone. They sit by the fire while you tell their stories.
divinity.prayer: Forget them and they forget you back.

divinity.name: Hreinwald
divinity.description: Hreinwald is the Sea-King of the Nordvyg, lord of grey water, patron of the longship and the prow-raven.
divinity.effects: Naval combat morale; ship-handling bonus; piety on successful raids.
divinity.lore: Hreinwald rules where the keel touches the deep. No oath sworn on the wave is broken without his notice.
divinity.prayer: Pour seawater over the prow before you push off.

divinity.name: Skǫll
divinity.description: Skǫll is the Wolf of the Deep, who follows the longship in the wake. He is fed on the fear of those whose shore you reach.
divinity.effects: Bonus loot on raids; reduced relations penalty for sacking villages.
divinity.lore: Skǫll does not bless the man who never sails. He is for those who follow the prow.
divinity.prayer: Feed him before he chooses to feed himself.
